about: Frontend expert with over 15 years of experience. I specialise in the architecture of high-load SPA and SSR applications built with Vue 3 (Nuxt) and React (Next.js). I design products from scratch: from a design system in Figma to CI/CD setup and code review processes. I am looking for a developer role in a product company with a strong engineering culture.
competencies: Migration of legacy code to modern stacks.
Adoption of E2E testing (Playwright) in development pipelines.
Integration of AI tools (Claude, OpenAI, DeepSeek) into workflows.
